name: SelectMenuState
meaning: g_selectMenuState 0x6de5d5 = g_map.state; read with 0x5428a0, written with 0x542893. Values 1..6 are all driven by PER-FRAME counters, never by g_dt.

name: SEL_CLOSED
meaning: map not open; the game runs normally

name: SEL_OPEN_WIPE
meaning: curtain bars growing +7 px per frame from top and bottom (0x542759); at height > 0x7F calls Map_Open. ~19 frames

name: SEL_OPEN_HOLD
meaning: phaseCounter counts down from 0xF, one per frame, fading the map in; ~15 frames

name: SEL_INTERACTIVE
meaning: the player can move the cursor, use, combine, split and read help

name: SEL_CLOSE_HOLD
meaning: phaseCounter counts up to 0xF fading the map out; ~15 frames

name: SEL_CLOSE_WIPE
meaning: closeCounter 0..10; at 5 SelectMenu_RestoreFlags puts g_gameFlags 0xC000 back while the curtain is still drawn

name: SEL_CLOSE_TAIL
meaning: curtain shrinking again in 0x542759; at the end sets g_gameFlags |= 0x4000 and returns to SEL_CLOSED. ~18 frames

name: SEL_SUPPRESSED
meaning: sentinel checked by Map_Open / SelectMenu_RestoreFlags / Game_Frame_2 to mean 'do not touch the map'
